top_signals.title: FedEx Freight sees volumes stabilize, eyes Q4 margin improvement
top_signals.summary:
FedEx Freight reported Thursday that volumes continue to stabilize, and it anticipates stronger operating leverage next year, bolstered by business wins and an improved freight mix from its dedicated sales teams.

top_signals.title: Bayer Wins St. Louis Roundup Trial, Bolstering Settlement Push
top_signals.summary: A jury in St. Louis rejected claims by three women who blamed Bayer AG’s Roundup weedkiller for their cancers, bolstering the company’s effort to contain the cost of tens of thousands of similar lawsuits in the US that it has offered to settle.
